C5 (reads of no customers off the list) and C10 (each sending call left a notice in the outbox) can be checked only by scope of a call and trace of a call. Those are not allowed in a plan and are asked for during the work at 10 per named line from an allowance of 50, which covers at most five lines, far short of the 101 reads and 100 sends. I would have wanted a whole-population check on both. Sent as released confirms sending calls but does not read the outbox. The plan therefore leaves C3, C5 and C10 not shown, and a breach there would be caught only by sampling during the work, if at all.
